title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India

rule_6_1_a.description: Name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer

rule_6_1_b.description: Country of origin for imported products

rule_6_1_c.description: Common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package

rule_6_1_d.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight, measure or number

rule_6_1_e.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported

rule_6_1_f.description: Best before or use by date, month and year for perishable items

rule_6_1_g.description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes, formatted as MRP Rs. xx.xx or Maximum Retail Price Rs. xx.xx incl. of all taxes

rule_6_1_h.description: Name, address, telephone number, email address of the person/office to contact in case of consumer complaints

rule_6_11.description: Unit sale price rounded off to the nearest rupee or paise (mandatory w.e.f. 2022 amendment)
